app.name: Photo clock tile
app.summary: A photo of an image entity over the whole page: at the bottom left how long ago, where and when it was taken; at the top right the time and the temperature inside and outside.
app.tile_example: A photo over the page: 2 years ago, Wilmington, NC, September 9, 2024 · 9:08 AM, and 10:38 PM · 71° · 46°
app.date_attribute_hint: The attribute of the image entity that holds the day the photo was taken. Immich Random Image calls it media_localdatetime. Nothing shows when the photo has none.
app.tap_action_hint: What a tap on the photo does. The tile's own Tap setting must stay on Auto.
app.tap_page_hint: The page a tap opens, as the editor counts them (1 is the first).
app.tap_entity_hint: For Press a button or Run a script: its entity, such as button.immich_photo_cycle_album_refresh_image for the next photo.
app.outside_hint: A weather entity (its temperature), a temperature sensor or a thermostat (its current temperature). Starts with Forecast Home.
app.inside_hint: A temperature sensor or a thermostat (its current temperature). The kitchen screen starts with the living room Nest.
app.show_time_taken_hint: The time of day the photo was taken, beside its date.
app.show_ago_hint: Such as 2 years ago, or On this day when it was taken on today's date.
app.location_hint: Optional. A sensor or text helper for the photo's place: its city and state attributes (shown as Wilmington, NC), or else its state as written, such as Wilmington, NC. Unset or unavailable hides the line.
